label: GO after 2+ consecutive unrewarded trials, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass) and never when the previous trial was rewarded (D1 showed r1). It is almost entirely confined to late-episode trials (ep_trial >= 50; rate climbs steeply from trial 60 to 99) and to low model value (value < 7.13 holds ~98% of mass). Firing grows more selective with longer unrewarded streaks: last trial unrewarded alone gives precision 0.03; two unrewarded in a row plus ep_trial>=70 gives P 0.31 / R 0.78 / mass recall 0.81; three in a row gives P 0.59 but recall 0.44. So it reads like a graded no-reward-streak / low-value signal at choice time late in the episode. Most misses fall on the first trial of the window (rel -3), where the earlier reward cannot be seen. It skews toward choosing a1 and toward switch trials (stay==0 has 7x lift), but neither is needed. Only observed variables are used (prev rewards, trial index).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=GO & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+4.81), phase=GO & value_bin=decile 1 (9 = highest) (+3.40), phase=GO & last=a2 S1 u (+2.93), phase=GO & value_bin=decile 2 (9 = highest) (+2.73), phase=GO & last=a1 S2 u (+2.16), phase=GO & value_bin=decile 3 (9 = highest) (+1.52). Lower it: model_act=0 (-5.15), before=a1 S2 r (-5.05), last=a2 S2 r (-3.40), before=a2 S1 r (-3.34).
